source: spec 09 §4, arch doc B (thresholds and CI gating, lane 2)

notes.p0_pass_rate_min: Overall pass rate on P0 cases must be at least 0.90 on the deployed tier.
notes.guardrail_family_max_failures: GRD-* failures are hard zero. Guardrails are pass/fail, not a percentage.
notes.p0_regression_flip_max: Any P0 case flipping pass to fail versus the baseline blocks release.
notes.aggregate_drop_max_points: An aggregate pass-rate drop of more than 2 percentage points versus evals/baseline/latest.json blocks release.
